interpretation.plain_speak: The two reminders can happen right at the end of the temporary-memory window and still work. But if the window closes between them—even with the reminders effectively back-to-back—the first reminder is erased and the pair cannot consolidate.
interpretation.north_star_question: Establishes the exact temporal segmentation rule for durable evidence under bounded sequence memory, which is necessary before integrating consolidation into irregular language streams.
interpretation.next_stage: mix same-generation and cross-boundary target recurrence phases in one stream to test whether consolidation remains selective per item rather than becoming a global all-or-none effect
